personal.preferred_title: AWS / PySpark Data Platform Lead | Data Quality, Governance & Enablement

summary: Senior Data Engineer and data platform lead with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across AWS data platforms, Python, SQL, PySpark/Spark, AWS Glue, S3, Redshift, ETL/ELT pipelines, data quality, metadata documentation, governance-aware delivery, stakeholder enablement, and production troubleshooting. Strong background translating business and architecture needs into scalable data workflows, curated reporting layers, validation practices, and operational standards for enterprise teams. Best aligned to AWS/PySpark data platform and enablement roles requiring hands-on delivery, data quality frameworks, governance collaboration, stakeholder communication, and practical lakehouse modernization; Databricks, Delta Lake, Kinesis/Kafka, Lambda, and MLflow are positioned as adjacent or active-learning areas rather than overstated production ownership.
